prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot, head to toe, five-material body (symmetric), every seam physically stepped, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman standing, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, the camera set back so her whole body fits in the frame from the top of her head to her feet, her face still sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Filipina woman in pageant glam makeup — warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, long voluminous chestnut waves, a bright, confident pageant smile. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a bright beaded drop earring.

Physique: A towering, immensely powerful woman standing full height on long legs, never short or squat, the body of a world's strongest woman under a thick layer of soft fat — enormously broad thick shoulders, massive arms, a colossal chest, a huge barrel torso with a big round belly, no waist at all, her left arm crystal, her right arm carved stone, her torso a glass vessel, her legs vessel and vessel.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent soft pink rose quartz, one continuous carved mass, never hollow. Light passes straight through it. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid white Carrara marble veined with soft grey streaks, completely opaque, completely opaque. No light passes through it — only reflections on its polished surface.

Torso (chest, belly, hips): a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled completely to the brim with clear clear periwinkle-blue water with drifting feathers, no hollow space, no air gap. Small bright fish and slow-drifting water plants move freely through it, rising to the collarbone line itself.

Left leg (hip to foot): a sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars, sealing shut at a matching glass sandal, the water continuing unbroken through the ankle and every toe. Right leg (hip to foot): a sculpted vessel of clear glass (unmistakably glass, crystal-clear and polished, bright specular reflections) filled with clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars, sealing shut at a matching glass sandal, the water continuing unbroken through the ankle and every toe.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a bright cobalt blue on one side and a warm golden yellow on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so blue light glances off one side and yellow light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
